name.bs: Lažna SMS kazna za saobraćajni prekršaj: „platite odmah putem linka“
name.en: Fake traffic fine text: “pay now via the link”

how.bs: SMS u ime IDDEEA-e, MUP-a ili sistema „E-Policija“ javlja da je vaše vozilo snimljeno zbog prekoračenja brzine ili drugog prekršaja. Prijeti pravnim posljedicama ako kaznu ne platite brzo i šalje link, ponekad uz uputu da ga kopirate u preglednik. Lažna stranica traži lične podatke i podatke kartice. IDDEEA ne izdaje kazne, a policija ne naplaćuje kazne SMS-om.
how.en: A text in the name of IDDEEA, the Interior Ministry or an “E-Policija” system says your vehicle was recorded speeding or committing another offence. It threatens legal consequences if you don’t pay quickly and sends a link, sometimes telling you to copy it into your browser. The fake page asks for personal and card details. IDDEEA doesn’t issue fines and the police don’t collect fines by text.

text.bs: SMS „policije“ ili IDDEEA-e: vozilo snimljeno u prekršaju.
text.en: A “police” or IDDEEA text: your vehicle was recorded committing an offence.

text.bs: Platite odmah ili slijede sud i veća kazna.
text.en: Pay now or court and a bigger fine follow.

text.bs: Link, ponekad uz uputu da ga kopirate u preglednik.
text.en: A link, sometimes with an instruction to copy it into your browser.
The page asks for card details.

text.bs: E-Policija: Vase vozilo evidentirano je kamerom zbog prekoracenja brzine. Neplacena kazna: 100 KM. Ukoliko uplata ne bude izvrsena danas, predmet se upucuje sudu. Kopirajte link u preglednik: [link]
text.en: E-Policija: Your vehicle was recorded by camera for speeding. Unpaid fine: 100 KM. If payment isn’t made today, the case goes to court. Copy the link into your browser: [link]

bs: sms kazna za prekoračenje brzine link
vozilo snimljeno kamerom plaćanje preko linka
en: text about a speeding fine with a link
iddeea message about a traffic offence
e policija text pay the fine
vehicle caught on camera pay via link

bs: IDDEEA ne izdaje ni ne naplaćuje saobraćajne kazne i ne šalje linkove za plaćanje.
Policija ne šalje SMS s linkom za plaćanje kazne.
Poruka sa stranog broja i prijetnja sudom.
Uputa da link kopirate u preglednik služi zaobilaženju zaštite.
en: IDDEEA doesn’t issue or collect traffic fines and doesn’t send payment links.
The police don’t send texts with a link to pay a fine.
A message from a foreign number and a threat of court.
An instruction to copy the link into your browser is meant to get around protection.

bs: Ne otvarajte link i ne odgovarajte.
Ako mislite da imate kaznu, provjerite u policijskoj stanici ili na službenoj stranici.
Ako ste upisali karticu, zovite banku; poruku prijavite policiji.
en: Don’t open the link or reply.
If you think you have a fine, check at a police station or on the official website.
If you entered your card, call your bank; report the message to the police.
